description: Create a new draft release for one of the person's artist projects and return its ID. Nothing is public: a draft is only visible to the person. Next steps: upload the audio of every track and the cover with studio_upload_prepare (one upload URL per file), attach each file with studio_upload_finish, check with studio_release_get that all tracks are ready, then submit with studio_release_submit. Limit of open drafts per artist project.

aiGenerated.description: AI labelling: no (made without AI), partly or yes (AI generated). Needed before submitting

genre.description: Main genre, one of: Electronic, House, Techno, Trance, Ambient, Downtempo, Synthwave, Pop, Rock, Indie, Jazz, Classical, Hip-Hop, Soundtrack, Experimental, RnB, Metal, Folk, Blues, Country, Reggae, Latin, World, DrumAndBass, Dubstep, Schlager, Kids, SpokenWord, Other

priceEur.description: Price of the whole release in EUR (0-1000)

secondaryGenre.description: Optional second genre, must differ from genre

type.description: Release type: album, ep or single (default album)

upc.description: UPC/EAN barcode (12 or 13 digits), if there is one

name: studio_release_create
title: Create a new release
